name: ERP RevoGrid Gate 5B-5 — Same Filter Re-Apply Refresh Fix
base: Gate 5B-5 Insert/Delete + real browser trace diagnostics
problem: Re-applying an unchanged filter after Edit/Paste/Insert closed the popup as a no-op, so rows that no longer matched remained visible.
behavior: Apply with unchanged criteria re-runs RevoGrid native FilterPlugin when the working view differs from the current criteria.
The refresh is one Sheet History action only when it actually changes filter visibility.
Undo/Redo restores the exact filter working snapshot by storing only differing ClientKey identities, never a full row snapshot.
Filter remains view state only and does not enter Change Engine Dirty or Save.
RevoGrid source code is not modified.

verification.real_browser_trace: Must be rerun on user machine at fixed port 5265
verification.dotnet_build: Must be run on user machine
